 Follow Inside Jessica Chastain's marriage to Italian nobleman husband and rarely-seen two kids
 Nova M Bajamonti Thu, November 5, 2026 at 9:31 PM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. (Gilbert Flores) Jessica Chastain has a thriving life on-camera and off.
 The actress put a lot of work into her craft and studied at Sacramento City College, American Academy of Dramatic Arts, as well as The Julliard School.
 She has had a successful decades-long career in entertainment, and most recently starred in blockbuster movies such as Dreams, Mothers' Instinct, Memory, The Eyes of Tammy Faye and much more.
 Outside of her booming career in the arts, she is happily married to Gian Luca Passi de Preposulo, and has two children. Learn all about her family life below.
 Who is Gian Luca Passi de Preposulo?
 Gian was raised in Carbonera, Italy, and he moved to Milan when he was 18 years old in pursuit of a fashion career.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Despite the country's aristocracy being diminished in 1946, had it continued today, Gian would have been a Count, being that his father was Count Alberto Passi de Preposulo. In fact, his family's aristocratic roots date back to 973, believe it or not.
 Gian himself doesn't pay attention to the title, whether existent or dissolved, explaining to Vanity Fair : "It's not the title that's important—you have to be a count inside yourself." 
 He has his own prosecco brand called Fiol, which he launched in 2010 with two of his childhood friends. Gian is also the proud chairman of the Red Bull Italy SailGP Team.
 Gian currently works for Moncler, where he focuses on events and celebrity clients. Prior to that, he worked public relations for Armani.
 About Jessica Chastain and Gian Luca Passi de Preposulo's relationship
 The duo romantically met in Paris in 2012 at the Giorgio Armani Privé Haute Couture fashion show. 
 Advertisement Advertisement It was also a special day for the actress being that she had just found out she was nominated for an Oscar for her role in The Help. The sparks flew and the couple went public the following year.
 They tied the knot at his family's 17th century villa called the Villa Tiepolo Passi in 2017. The pair welcomed their firstborn Giulietta in 2018, and their second child Augustus in 2020.

 About Jessica Chastain and Gian Luca Passi de Preposulo's children
 The couple tend to keep their children out of the private eye, however, they have made rare appearances over the years.
 Last year, when Jessica was honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, her husband and children came along for the ride.
 Advertisement Advertisement The family enjoyed the 2024 Paris Olympics  together, as they watched the women's artistic gymnastics.
 Motherhood has positively affected Jessica. When the star was acting in and producing the film The 355 , she made sure to support working moms on set, who were in the same position that she was in.
 She revealed to Entertainment Tonight: "I love bringing families on set. We had a trailer that was for children, and how wonderful that, yes we can be successful and wonderful at our work, but we can also not have to shut down part of our life in order to do so."
